training.FM_scope: Online own-arm training FM; distributions differ across arms, not a common validation loss.
training.call_timestamp_span_scope: Includes pauses between calls; not pure GPU time.
training.cuda_peak_scope: Max over reset-per-update counters including backward/optimizer; excludes CUDA context/external allocations.
training.resource_scope: Device numbers include unrelated processes; sampled maxima are not continuous peaks. Process memory may be unavailable in WDDM.
training.timing_note: Call/update times nest within wall time; do not add nested phases.
